html:
SMTO-TSK-0040 — The Agent marked the wrong step as its current one

GUID: c1a0cf21-c1c6-4366-8154-d7d79021e47b
Slug: task-board-active-invalid
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • The Agent tried to mark a step as the one it is working on, but that step didn't exist or another step was already marked. Its plan wasn't changed, and the Agent usually fixes this itself.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the task's activity for a moment; the Agent normally tries again and shows Updated tasks soon after. The Agent receives this message and can pick a single valid current step.
  2. If Task update failed keeps appearing, select Stop, then send a message telling the Agent which step to work on first. Naming one step to start with helps the Agent mark just one step as current.
  3. If it keeps happening, open Technical details in this panel and select Copy error details. The details show which step the Agent tried to mark.

What success looks like

  • The task's activity shows Updated tasks and the work continues.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't edit or delete the task's saved data by hand; the earlier plan is still intact.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A manage_tasks board revision set active_task_id to a task that is not on the board, or would leave more than one board task with status active.

What this means

  • active_task_id names no existing board task, or the resulting board has more than one task marked active. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • active_task_id names no existing board task, or the resulting board has more than one task marked active.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the complete proposed board revision, including unchanged entries that may already be active.

How to fix it

  • In the manage_tasks call, set active_task_id to an existing board task ID or null (this demotes any other active entry to pending); when active_task_id is omitted, upsert at most one entry with status active. Background jobs may still run concurrently under waiting_job; the revision is rejected atomically and can be resubmitted corrected.
  • Select exactly one existing active task or clear the active selection. Background jobs may remain concurrent under their own authority.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The atomic board revision contains at most one valid active task.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
